# Package list of the RUN environment (also used by the assistant).
#
# Source: `site-packages/*.dist-info` (a directory walk), not `pip freeze`: on a
# degraded NFS `pip freeze` was too slow while a single readdir answered at once.
# The list is no poorer for that: dist-info is what `pip freeze` builds its output from.
#
# The base under this list is conda, and NOTHING beyond it is installed through conda:
#   python 3.12.13, pip 26.0.1, wheel 0.46.3, packaging 26.0 (+ system
#   libgcc/libstdcxx/openssl/sqlite/tk/xz/zlib and xorg-lib* for VTK).
# Everything else is pip; pip/wheel/packaging are managed by conda and not listed here.
#
# Rebuilt with `agent/env/build_env.sh`. After installing, check the OUTCOME, not
# that the install was legal: `agent/run_tests.sh --python <new python>` and
# `agent/tools/preflight.py`. `_cad_grad` is separate: it is tied to the interpreter
# ABI and built with `agent/tools/build_cad_grad.sh`, otherwise the optimizer is
# silently disabled.
